title: Ovation Rooftop Hot Tub Sleeps 12 Broadway Shuttle
description:
Welcome to **The New Cumberland**, Nashville's premier luxury resort destination. Enjoy designer townhomes, skyline views, and exceptional resort amenities just minutes from downtown. Thursday - Sunday bookings include COMPLIMENTARY LUXURY TRANSPORTATION to and from downtown. Every stay is thoughtfully designed to deliver a true five-star experience and unforgettable Music City memories.

The space
Imagine arriving at your own luxury townhome just minutes from downtown Nashville.
As you step inside, you're welcomed by beautifully designed interiors, soaring ceilings, elegant furnishings, and expansive gathering spaces created for making memories together.
Mornings begin with coffee on your private rooftop while watching the Nashville skyline wake up.
Spend your day exploring Broadway, the Country Music Hall of Fame, boutique shopping, live music, or family attractions before returning to your own private resort.
As evening falls, relax in your rooftop hot tub beneath the stars, gather around the dining table with family and friends, or enjoy cocktails while taking in panoramic skyline views.
Unlike traditional vacation rentals, The New Cumberland offers an elevated resort experience complete with concierge services, a resort-style pool, seasonal live entertainment, and The Crystal Atrium—our stunning all-glass event venue.
Whether you're celebrating a wedding, family reunion, birthday, girls' getaway, bachelor weekend, business retreat, or simply looking for Nashville's most luxurious accommodations, you'll discover why guests return to The New Cumberland again and again.
Luxury isn't just where you stay.
It's how you feel while you're here.

Home Highlights:
• 4 bedrooms | 3.5 bathrooms Homes
• Private rooftops with hot tub(coming soon), fire pit & cabana seating
• Rooftop TV + TVs in every bedroom and living space
• Elevator in every home that has access to all floors(coming soon)
• Fully stocked kitchen with modern appliances
• Parking included
• Luxury linens, bath towels & beach towels
• Hotel-style toiletries provided
• High-speed WiFi throughout

Explore Music City
You'll enjoy a peaceful luxury retreat while staying just minutes from Nashville's most popular attractions.

📍 Less than 6 miles from Downtown Nashville
